## Why

The existing independent readers cover geometry, ownership and explicit following. Hinge declarations still need a separately defined observation boundary before a reader can be implemented. The original GLBs expose joint fields but no direct site table, hinge-definition IDs or hinge/site source spans.

## Change

Adds the versioned C260 contract, field-origin mapping, exact input inspection and 28 explicitly unrun future control groups for the existing C253 public family. The finite subset covers ordered site endpoints, signed basis axes and literal angular limits/initial values. Source-derived site facts remain distinct from artifact claims. Updates current project navigation and retains both original review findings and exact first-draft bytes.

No hinge-reader implementation, runtime/exporter change, fixture modification, hosted workflow change or trial is included. Full semantic/world-motion/revision/rebuild qualification remains pending.

## Review and checks

Independent contract review approves exact CONTRACT SHA-256 `39bf90c51256cb392b0b639c36f3325c76f8919bbea4e3e572937e9834f8cd6c`, with 242 fixed-input/document assertions and 142 object-source mapping assertions. These are audit assertions, not implementation tests.

Clean candidate `87d7cdab441222cda75958e61fd9da369ec8c5a3` passes documentation preservation (29 sources, 233 sections, 5,561 local links) and the unchanged C253 manifest (14 files, three cases), on Linux x86-64 / CPython3.12.14. Published head `f7689bf80c91c525d6cd0977ab8c99a4f9c5e30c` has exactly the checked tree `0e9b91f56e184032adf00cae97abda71201cc9dd`. The initial integration candidate's six relative-link failures are preserved; original Markdown bytes now use explicit archival `.source` suffixes and a relocation index.

The final evidence-wording correction is published at `f80dc7d333a94c111290749dec3438c66e206f26`, tree `46ebb950453012fe827dfdf072fa00d18327940a`, equal to local candidate `88d6c6e56cccd1b6bad259a3176b10a4b5a37770`. Fresh documentation checks on this corrected candidate pass all 29 sources, 233 sections and 5,561 links. All C253 inputs and seven approved contract files remain unchanged. Final integration review and resulting-main checks remain required before source closure. Main lease owner is `c260-root-a827454f4cb7-20261117`, expected base `de69dfd97cae264ed050bd9c1b0813cd643b6ac7`, expiry2026-11-17T20:24:08Z. Merge must guard this exact published head, verify history retention and branch deletion, release ownership, then finish only the verified saved handoff under #247. This PR does not auto-close the delivery scope.

C234 cleanup remains in #240. C174's former archive branch is absent; historical commit accessibility does not establish complete graph retention.
